retention_decision.restriction: Retain only on the experimental renderer stack. Both designated target latency and peak-RSS gates pass, and the exact conversion adds no storage or accuracy change. The 32 protected latency misses and 21 RSS misses remain open; no protected median or p95 lower bound exceeds 1.02 in this confirmation. This absence does not establish non-regression. Largest observed RSS increases are outline2-knockout Exact (+35.2%, 18.5 to 25.015625 MiB), default-knockout64 Exact (+31.1%, 46.328125 to 60.71875 MiB), and opaque-fill Exact (+24.4%, 4.671875 to 5.8125 MiB). No memory-noise allowance, gate relaxation, release promotion or competitor-dominance claim is made. Earlier stack regressions and nonopaque-background costs remain open. Keep the useful measured target gains while profiling the next separately frozen slice.
retention_decision.review: Coordinator inspected all46 confirmation cells, independent audit, accuracy probes, full repository check and WASI screen before deciding. Same-binary RSS diagnostic cannot change this decision evidence.

limitations: Incremental native synthetic workload result against f98ad836, not a net legacy-stack or competitor comparison.
Measured dirty source on f98ad836 is pinned by full product fingerprints and hash-bound binaries before later commit.
Baseline native binary is reused from the previous guarded experiment with matching product fingerprint; not independently rebuilt.
No historical or pilot samples are pooled into confirmation.
Bootstrap bounds come from the frozen harness and are not independently recomputed. Bounds are marginal; 200 pairs do not establish calibrated p95 or simultaneous coverage.
Peak RSS is the fresh renderer child OS high-water value across the whole process; unchanged explicit storage does not erase observed misses.
WASI fresh-process diagnostic excludes startup/explicit compile/instantiate; lazy tiering may occur inside render. Linear memory is not total memory or RSS.
Opaque-background timing matrix. Earlier nonopaque-background F64 cost and original shared-composition speed/RSS costs remain open.
Known-process observation can miss short or unrecognized jobs. No controlled-runner certification, holdout or worldwide superiority evidence.
